name: Question 15
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14129500/assets/cb3e769d81d6c48656d7d971d274deec87239b089e6c41f74a23036c554c4bb6.png)

What multiplication problem is represented by the model above?
worked_solution:
We have $\frac{1}{7}$ on the left and $\frac{4}{7}$ on the right.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14129500/assets/81ad161de883e5c7db92aa42d97167da3e90347508c86869bb96ff0f1e04bf29.png)

Therefore, we have

$$
\frac{1}{7}\times 4=\frac{4}{7}.
$$
